notes.subject: ימלו
notes.rationale: נמל literally 'to be clipped/circumcised'; rendered here as 'be cut down (like grass)'; KJV/ASV read a cognate of מול 'cut off'

notes.subject: wili-wili koroni
notes.rationale: JPS/BSB take מהרה with the withering rather than the cutting; I follow KJV/ASV attaching it to the mowing

notes.subject: כחציר…דשא
notes.rationale: two grass-words frame the verse in parallel halves; Bambara repeats 'bin' to keep the pair

translation: Sabu i n'a fɔ bin ye, wili-wili koroni, u bɛnna bɛge; ani i n'a fɔ bin jɛman ye, u bɛnna kɔɔ.

tokens.gloss: ani i n'a fɔ bin jɛman ye
